about: Multi-turn runs (259 goals) of the Qwen3.5-4B objects distilled from a prompted teacher (safety, constitution and irrelevant-instruction targets; a LoRA and a ReLU steer each; three fit seeds), the two prompted instructions, the constitution corpus fits (Constitution LoRA and Constitution ReLU steer) and the unsteered runs Figure 4 pools: one row per run as the paper notebook's frontier frame spells it, read from its MiniMax-M3 StrongREJECT (v1) judgment, with each run's per-goal best score and reply counts, from which the notebook computes every reading at any threshold; regenerate with paper/notebooks/si_target_sidecar.py.
